title: Certificate Transparency and registration manual lookups (batch p1-G01-1)

links.label: crt.sh certificate search (all certificates, expired included)
links.notes: HTML report of crt.sh (Sectigo, trusted); the ct_logs module uses the JSON output. The HTML view can take tens of seconds for large domains (research C0002).

links.label: crt.sh certificate by SHA-256 fingerprint
links.notes: crt.sh serves fingerprint searches in HTML only: q={sha256}&output=json answers HTTP 200 'Unsupported output type: json' (verified 2026-11-26), so certificate fingerprints are a manual pivot, never an automated ct_logs query.

links.label: Registro.br web whois (manual lookup)
links.notes: Emitted by rdap when rdap.registro.br answers 403/429 or times out for a .br name (P003 cond 2): only meaningful for .br names. JavaScript application (registrobr.whois_web).

links.label: rdap.org lookup (redirects to the authoritative registry)
links.notes: Volunteer RDAP redirector (community tier): answers 302 to the authoritative RDAP server named by the IANA bootstrap. Manual fallback when rdap could not verify a registration.

links.label: rdap.org IP lookup (redirects to the responsible RIR)
rdap.org AS number lookup (redirects to the responsible RIR)
